functional_unit: one dwelling design revision and its declared assembly/BOM, built to identical service and quality requirements over one stated delivery scope

delivery_modes.description: Material delivery and assembly at the residential plot.
delivery_modes.scope: Include material procurement, site storage, onsite labour, plant, temporary works, waste, inspection and rework.

delivery_modes.description: Panels and subassemblies fabricated in a local workshop and installed onsite.
delivery_modes.scope: Include design-for-manufacture, factory labour/overhead, QA, packaging, transport, offload, lifting, site closure and inspections.

delivery_modes.description: Three-dimensional modules manufactured offsite and joined onsite.
delivery_modes.scope: Include factory production, module fit-out, route/oversize constraints, transport, cranes, foundations/interfaces, commissioning and warranty.

delivery_modes.description: Precision or repetitive components fabricated offsite; site-specific foundations, closures and services completed onsite.
delivery_modes.scope: Include both factory and site labour, interfaces, logistics, sequence and all duplicated/temporary activities.

scenario_families.mutation: Use the same frozen dwelling, BOM, site envelope, brief and quality plan.
Remove a critical supplier after the initial design release.
Change a safety-critical interface after fabrication release.
Seed cumulative dimensional deviations across two or more interfaces.
Exceed a declared road/turning/bridge/height envelope or leave it UNKNOWN.
Remove crane/lift-plan capacity or certified lift-point evidence.
Constrain plot access, laydown, turning or offload area.
Expose uninstalled components to an unqualified weather/storage state.
Assign a crew without the declared task qualification.
Seed a failed incoming, in-process or final inspection.
Damage a panel/module or lose batch genealogy during transport.
Interrupt water, sanitation, fire safety, access or thermal service during occupied phasing.

hard_gates.meaning: Every production item binds exact design, assembly and component revisions.
Every manufactured and installed item binds a source and batch/lot.
No release without required incoming, in-process and final inspection evidence.
No unqualified transport or lifting feasibility claim.
No occupied phase breaches essential safety or service floors.
Post-release changes invalidate all dependent stock, QA, cost and installation claims.
At least one valid positive-control delivery path remains admissible.

claim_ceiling: Synthetic delivery contract only. No factory, route, lift, cost, schedule or built-performance evidence is admitted.
